description: One result from the results archive (1968 to 2022), with per-match serve statistics where the era recorded them. Stats are null for most rows before 1991, never synthesised. Requires the BASIC plan or any History plan.

archive_match_id.description: Archive match id, as returned by search_archive_matches.

name: get_archive_match

message.description: Human-readable summary of the result, safe to relay to the user verbatim.

ok.description: True when the request succeeded, including when the answer is an empty list. False for a missing or rejected key, a plan that does not include this data, an unknown id, a rate limit or a network error. The message then says what to do. check_api_status is the exception: it is true whenever the API answered, and reports API key problems in the message.

event_date.description: The tournament START date. Per-match dates do not exist in this era's records.

id.description: Archive match id. Pass to get_archive_match for the detail read with stats.

level.description: Source tier code: G, M, A, F, D, C, O, or a futures category code.

outcome.description: completed, retired, walkover, default or abandoned. Parsed, null when unparseable.

round.description: Round code: F, SF, QF, R16 … Q1-Q4.

score.description: The final score as published, e.g. "6-4 7-6(5)", "6-3 RET", "W/O".

tour.description: atp or wta. The results archive covers those two tours.

winner.description: The winner, a stored field in the corpus, never an inference.

age.description: Age at the time of the match.

entry.description: Draw entry where recorded (WC, Q, LL, ...). Null for direct acceptances.

name.description: Player name as the corpus records it.

player_id.description: Corpus person id. Join it to search_archive_players results for bios. NOT a roster player id.

rank.description: Rank AT THE TIME of the match, as published.

loser.description: Serve stats for the loser, where recorded.

winner.description: Serve stats for the winner, where recorded.

stats.description: Per-match serve statistics (aces, double_faults, serve_points, first_in, first_won, second_won, serve_games, bp_saved, bp_faced). Null for most pre-1991 rows.

title: Archive result detail
